purpose: Teach: 魅せ/お粗末/下品/愕然/幾分/すわっ/ふみ/成り行き

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ダンスで皆を魅せてたな
lines.en: You were really something on that dance floor, Riku.
lines.style: Warm observation with a teasing edge. Direct eye contact. The compliment is genuine but delivered casual, like she's not making it a big thing. Slight smirk.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、お粗末な作品って言ってたけど良かったぞ、桜
lines.en: You said my piece was clumsy, but it actually worked, didn't it, Sakura.
lines.style: Soft deflection of the compliment. Not quite meeting her eyes — a little embarrassed by being called out. Testing whether she meant it. Slight upturn at the end.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、下品なネタはやめろよ
lines.en: Don't pull that crude stuff again, Riku.
lines.style: Sharp, warning but not angry. Quick tempo. The tone of someone setting a boundary she's had to set before. No room for negotiation in her voice.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、成績を見て愕然としてたな、桜
lines.en: I saw you just sitting there stunned when you got your grade back.
lines.style: Wry amusement. Slight laugh threaded underneath. Mimicking his shock with her voice — almost teasing him for it. Warm undertone despite the observation.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、最近幾分大人っぽくなったな
lines.en: You've gotten a lot more grown-up lately, haven't you.
lines.style: Genuine observation with a hint of surprise in it. Slower pace — she's actually noticing this. Not quite sure how to land the compliment. Slight vulnerability underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、教壇の前ですわって考え込んでたな、桜
lines.en: I watched you sitting at the front, just thinking about something for a long time.
lines.style: Quieter, more observant. She's noting something real — concern threaded underneath the wry surface. Not accusatory, just noticing. Gentle landing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ふみ慣れた道で迷ったろ
lines.en: You got lost, didn't you. On a path you've walked a hundred times.
lines.style: Knowing but not unkind. She's recognizing something bigger than just a lost moment. Slight pause before the second sentence. Weight to it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、成り行き任せの計画はやめようぜ、桜
lines.en: Let's stop just drifting through plans, okay, Sakura. Let's actually decide.
lines.style: Firmer than before. Direct address. He's moved from deflecting to actually saying what he thinks. Still careful with her — 'let's' not 'you need to' — but there's conviction underneath.
